name: pl-fetal-brain-mask
title: Automatic masking of fetal brain images using deep learning
description: Automatic masking of fetal brain images using deep learning

parameters.name: inputPathFilter
parameters.help: selection (glob) for which files to evaluate

parameters.name: overlay_background
parameters.help: multiplier for values of masked voxels, given as a comma-separated list of numbers [0, 1). '0.0' effectively produces the extracted brain. A low, non-zero value such as '0.2' produces volumes which are helpful for visualization.

parameters.name: no_smooth
parameters.help: skip post-processing on images including morphological closing and defragmentation

parameters.name: skipped_list
parameters.help: produce an output file containing the names of files which were skipped
